newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says '97 new borrowing higher than expected.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says '97 new borrowing higher than expected.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Wednesday Bonn's new borrowing in 1997 would be higher than previously expected because of the country's near-record unemployment levels.
Higher new borrowing would be "a logical consequence of the facts," Waigel told journalists, pointing to the country's four million unemployed.

Waigel said Bonn's unemployment payments depended in part on the development of the labour market, and that was something he could not influence. He saw tax increases as a last resort to cover a budget defict widened by unemployment expenditures.
